Lemma
1. Lemma 1.13\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0010 ↗ hanlin:lemma-interior-gradient-1 If $u$ is harmonic in $B_R(x_0)$ and continuous on the closure, then for every multi-index $\alpha $ of order $m$, \[ |D^\alpha u(x_0)|\le \frac{n^m e^{m-1}m!}{R^m} \max _{\overline{B_R(x_0)}}|u|. \]
Proof

\sketch Induct on $m$. Apply Lemma 1 to an $m$th derivative on a concentric smaller ball, use the induction estimate on the remaining radius, and choose $\theta =m/(m+1)$ in the radius split. The factor $\theta ^{-m}(1-\theta )^{-1}<e(m+1)$, and $\alpha _1!\cdots \alpha _n!\le m!$ gives the stated multi-index bound.

□
